title: How to Automate Communication Between Cleaning and Front Desk
summary: See how to automate the handoff between cleaning teams and front desk or reception staff.
body_markdown:
Automating communication between cleaning and front desk means a property's status — cleaned and ready, still in progress, flagged for an issue — updates automatically and is visible to both teams, instead of a phone call or message required for every single handoff. In **Jestor** , this uses the same shared task and Kanban structure connecting different teams.


The handoff between cleaning finishing and front desk confirming a property is guest-ready is one of the most time-sensitive coordination points in short-stay operations — and one of the easiest to structure well.


## What manual cleaning-to-front-desk handoffs cost


- A phone call or message required for every single property status update
- Front desk unsure whether a property is actually ready without checking manually
- No shared record of when cleaning actually finished for a given turnover
- Delays in guest check-in caused by unclear property-ready status


## How automated handoff communication works


- Cleaning staff marking a task complete automatically updates the property's status
- Front desk sees real-time status on a shared **Kanban** board, no phone call needed
- Automations can notify front desk the moment a property becomes ready
- If an issue is flagged during cleaning, it connects directly to the property's record


## Why Jestor fits this use case


- Status updates automatically, removing the need for manual handoff communication
- Both teams work from the same shared, real-time view
- Notifications reach the right team automatically as status changes
- Reduces the coordination delay between cleaning completion and guest check-in

## Frequently Asked Questions


**Does front desk need to check in manually with cleaning staff?** No, status updates automatically as cleaning tasks are completed. More at[jestor.com](https://www.jestor.com/?ref=blog.jestor.com) .


**Can an issue found during cleaning be flagged automatically?** Yes, connected directly to the property's record for follow-up.


**Does this require both teams to use the same device or location?** No, the shared view works across mobile and desktop regardless of location.
